author: CrakSEO
name: Backlink Checker: Backlinks, Referring Domains & Anchor Text by CrakSEO
description: Backlink checker for SEO: backlinks, referring domains and anchor text for any website or competitor. Link analysis for backlink audits and link building.

tools.name: get_api_credit_balance
tools.description: Free: API credit balance, availability and pricing for SEO data calls. Call first to confirm the connection.

tools.name: check_backlinks
tools.description: Backlink checker: total backlinks, referring domains, domain rank, spam score and the strongest backlinks (one per domain) for any domain or URL. Costs API credits per call.

target.description: Domain (example.com) or full page URL (https://example.com/page) to analyze.

limit.description: How many top backlinks to list, 1 to 100. Default 25.

tools.name: get_referring_domains
tools.description: Referring domains: the domains linking to a domain or URL, with their rank, backlink count, spam score and first-seen date, strongest first. Costs API credits per call.

target.description: Domain (example.com) or full page URL (https://example.com/page) to analyze.

limit.description: How many referring domains to list, 1 to 500. Default 100.

tools.name: get_backlink_anchors
tools.description: Backlink anchor texts: the anchors used in links to a domain or URL, with backlink and referring-domain counts per anchor. Costs API credits per call.

target.description: Domain (example.com) or full page URL (https://example.com/page) to analyze.

limit.description: How many anchors to list, 1 to 500. Default 100.
